title: Design System: Trade Republic API & MCP

display.purpose: Hero and final-CTA headlines only. Weight 740, tight tracking, balanced.

body.purpose: Default prose at 500; line-height 1.6 on dark (light type needs more air).

narrative.overview: The dark-native landing and connect experience for an unofficial, read-only tool that lets an AI agent read a portfolio. One idea: you talk, your account answers. An ink surface lit by a single Trade Republic red glow with a fine grain film; the centerpiece is a luminous, keyboard-driven command instrument where plain-English questions stream back real balances and deltas. One continuous world across four surfaces — landing, connect/auth flow, Scalar API reference, and markdown guide — sharing the same ink, red, TR Sans and glow. Native to Trade Republic's language, never impersonating the official product.
keyCharacteristics: Dark-native ink surface, lit by one Trade Republic red glow + fine grain.
One variable display typeface (TR Sans Display) carrying the whole hierarchy through weight (500→740).
An interactive, keyboard-driven command instrument as the signature moment.
Motion that clarifies, never bounces — exponential ease-out, buttery Lenis scroll, honored prefers-reduced-motion.
Financial numerics always tabular; green/red reserved strictly for gains/losses.

rules.name: The One Red Rule
rules.body: Trade Republic Red touches ≤10% of any screen. It is a signal and a light source, not a theme.

rules.name: The Two-Reds Rule
rules.body: The luminous #ff4034 is for light (glow, underline, dots, accents, red-on-dark text). The deeper #d92d22 is for button fills under white text. Never put white text on #ff4034; never use #d92d22 for a glow.

rules.name: The Green-Means-Money Rule
rules.body: Green appears only on a positive financial delta — never as decorative success.

rules.name: The Tonal-Depth Rule
rules.body: On dark, depth comes from stepping the ink ramp (BG → panel → panel-3), not from resting drop-shadows on ordinary surfaces.

rules.name: The Weight-Not-Width Rule
rules.body: Hierarchy is carried by weight (500→740) inside one family. Never introduce a second sans; never stretch body text into a display face.

rules.name: The Kicker-Restraint Rule
rules.body: The red kicker names a section theme, not scaffolding. If every section has one, delete most of them.

rules.name: The Tabular-Numbers Rule
rules.body: Every financial figure uses font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums.

rules.name: The Earned-Elevation Rule
rules.body: Standing shadows belong only to signature surfaces (instrument, dock, glow, toast). Content tiles are flat until hover.

rules.name: The Glass-Is-Rare Rule
rules.body: Glassmorphism exists in one place — the dock. Do not spread blur-and-glass to other panels.

rules.name: The Restrained-Glow Rule
rules.body: Red glow is atmosphere and emphasis (one hero glow, CTA halos, the instrument edge), not a coat of paint on every element.

dos: Do keep Trade Republic Red under ~10% of any screen — signal and light, not theme.
Do use #ff4034 for glow/accents/red-on-dark text, and #d92d22 for button fills under white text.
Do carry all hierarchy through TR Sans Display weights (500→740); pair only with mono for typed content.
Do set every financial figure in tabular numerics, and reserve green strictly for positive deltas.
Do build depth on dark by stepping the ink ramp; let standing shadow be earned by signature surfaces only.
Do keep glow sparse and purposeful (one hero glow, CTA halos, instrument edge).
Do gate scroll-reveal behind an html.js class so content is visible without JS (never ship a blank section).
Do keep every surface (landing, auth, docs) on the same tokens, and keep the unofficial disclaimer legible.
donts: Don't ship generic SaaS-landing clichés: no hero-metric block, no wall of identical icon cards, no gradient text, no uppercase kicker above every section.
Don't drift into corporate-bank gravitas: no navy-and-gold, no stock photography, no legalese.
Don't counterfeit Trade Republic — quote the brand cues, never clone the official site or bury the unaffiliated notice.
Don't put white text on #ff4034 (fails AA); use #d92d22. And don't let muted grays fall below their AA floors on ink.
Don't use a colored border-left/border-right stripe as an accent on cards, callouts, or list items.
Don't spread glassmorphism beyond the dock, or paint red glow onto every element.
Don't gate content visibility on a scroll transition, or leave the docs shells on their old off-brand blue/slate.
